course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice reporting simple information with sa att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Catching up after missing a fika or short meeting.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Passing along what someone said without turning it into a long story.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk after one of them missed a fika and summarize one or two things that were mentioned.

main_focus.name: reported speech with sa att
main_focus.description: Use sa att to report a simple statement, keeping Swedish tense choices natural.
model_examples: Hon sa att fikat började tidigare idag.
Han sa att han var sjuk.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sa att naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday catch-up language with a few clear reported statements.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker says they missed a fika or short update.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other speaker reports one or two simple statements with sa att.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the important point and move on.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat sa att with different everyday details

focus: the important information that was passed along
why the information matters for the next step

sentence_focus: one sentence reporting that someone was sick
one sentence asking what was discussed
one sentence combining reported information with a practical result
